children: Overview
Canada foreign exchange services provider's Q3 revenue rose 5% yr/yr, driven by Payments growth
Adjusted EPS for Q3 increased to $0.93 from $0.68 last year
Company repurchased 241,700 shares for $4.2 mln under NCIB during the year
Outlook
Company remains focused on revenue growth via branch expansion and enhanced online services
CXI continues to advance digital payments and diversify revenue to support long-term growth
Company notes ongoing macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties may impact travel-related demand
Result Drivers
PAYMENTS GROWTH - Payments revenue rose 54%, driven by higher transaction volumes from existing and new customers, and a 33% increase in business trading volumes
BANKNOTES DECLINE - Banknotes revenue fell 4%, mainly due to temporary branch closures and weaker travel demand amid macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty
WHOLESALE CLIENT ADDITIONS - Co added 21 new financial institution clients in wholesale banknotes during the quarter
